name: dentokudev-hero-video
description: Remotion workspace that renders the homepage hero video (webm/mp4/poster) into ../public/brand. Self-contained: does not touch the site's dependencies.

scripts.render: npm run render:mp4 && npm run render:poster
scripts.render:film: npm run render:film:music && npm run render:film:it && npm run render:film:en
scripts.render:film:it: remotion render LaunchFilmIt ../public/brand/launch-film-it.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k && remotion still LaunchFilmIt ../public/brand/launch-film-it-poster.jpg --frame=134 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82
scripts.render:film:en: remotion render LaunchFilmEn ../public/brand/launch-film-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k && remotion still LaunchFilmEn ../public/brand/launch-film-en-poster.jpg --frame=134 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82
scripts.render:hero2: npm run render:hero2:it && npm run render:hero2:en
scripts.render:hero2:it: remotion render StudioHeroIt ../public/brand/studio-hero-it.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=25 --muted && remotion still StudioHeroIt ../public/brand/studio-hero-it-poster.jpg --frame=60 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=80
scripts.render:hero2:en: remotion render StudioHeroEn ../public/brand/studio-hero-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=25 --muted && remotion still StudioHeroEn ../public/brand/studio-hero-en-poster.jpg --frame=60 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=80
